newsitem.title: USA: Suburban Bancorp to merge into Fifth Third.
newsitem.headline: Suburban Bancorp to merge into Fifth Third.

text.p: Suburban Bancorporation and Fifth Third Bancorp said they have executed a definitive merger agreement under which Suburban will be merged into Fifth Third Bancorp.
The merger deal provides that each outstanding share of Suburban will be converted into 0.24357 shares of Fifth Third common stock in a tax free exchange.
Based on the closing price of Fifth Third common stock, the deal has a value of about $32 million, or $20.64 per share, to Suburban stockholders.

The companies said the stock exchange ratio is subject to possible adjustment, and the actual value to be realized by Suburban stockholders will be dependent upon the trading value of Fifth Third common stock at the date of completion of the merger.
The merger is subject to shareholder and regulatory approval and satisfaction of other conditions and is expected to be completed in the third quarter.
"Fifth Third Bancorp is continually strengthening its commitment to the residents of Greater Cincinnati," said company president George Schaefer, Jr.

"The increased number of locations will increase our ability to provide convenient financial services and we're looking forward to offering our full range of products and services to Suburban customers. This acquisition will also continue to expand Fifth Third's position as the leading financial institution in the Greater Cincinnati area in both assets and deposits."
